verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost identical. In both, the Inkwell & Lantern logo has shrunk to an illegible thumbnail in the card's top-left corner, the brand's prominence is lost, and the kicker sits off-centre to make room for it. The fine print floats beside the CTA as a separate third column, and the bottom of the card is left empty. The only differences are the body-copy line breaks (A: 'stay as / long as… Tea and'; B: 'stay / as long… Tea / and') and the book sitting slightly lower in B. Neither difference makes one candidate better than the other.
